title: Step
description: A single step in a workflow. Every step carries an id, a natural-language intent (used by the healer when the step fails), and action-specific fields enforced by the discriminator on the 'action' property.

id.description: Step identifier, unique within the workflow. Referenced by the healer and in semantic diffs.

intent.description: Natural-language description of what this step achieves. Load-bearing: the healer uses this to re-derive the step when selectors fail.

action.description: The kind of action this step performs. Discriminator for the oneOf branches.

pre.description: Preconditions that must hold before this step runs. Failure here routes to triage, typically classifying as a site change or auth decay.

post.description: Postconditions that must hold after this step completes. The product of these across the workflow is what makes healing tractable.

onFail.description: What to do when this step fails after triage. 'retry' handles only transient flake; 'escalate_to_healer' is the default for selector/site-change failures.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time this step is allowed to take before the verifier marks it as 'possibly stuck'.

Target.title: Target
Target.description: A ranked list of ways to find the element this step acts on. Candidates are tried in order; order should be role -> testid -> text -> css -> visual.

kind.description: Selector strategy. Role-based locators survive redesigns best (they encode meaning, not layout); visual embeddings are the last-resort fallback.

value.description: The selector string, in the form expected by the 'kind'. For 'role': 'button[name="Submit"]'. For 'testid': 'submit-button'. For 'visual': an embedding reference such as 'emb_4f2a'.

ValueSource.title: ValueSource
ValueSource.description: A value supplied to a step. May be a literal string, a reference to a workflow parameter, or a reference to a vault secret. Secrets are never inlined.

param.description: Name of a workflow parameter declared in Workflow.parameters.

secret.description: Name of a secret declared in Workflow.secrets. Resolved from the vault at run time.

Condition.title: Condition
Condition.description: A boolean assertion about page state. Used in pre, post, assert, guard.if, and loop.while.

urlMatches.description: Regex or substring the current URL must match.

urlEquals.description: Exact URL the current page must have.

selectorVisible.description: CSS selector that must resolve to a visible element.

selectorAbsent.description: CSS selector that must not resolve to any element.

textPresent.description: Text that must appear anywhere on the page.

responseStatus.description: HTTP response status the most recent navigation or XHR must have returned.

Navigate.description: Navigate to a URL. Equivalent to page.goto().

waitUntil.description: Load state to wait for after navigation.

Click.description: Click an element. Equivalent to locator.click().

Fill.description: Type a value into a form field. Equivalent to locator.fill().

Extract.description: Pull structured data out of the page into a typed shape. The schema field is a JSON Schema fragment the extracted value must conform to.

schema.description: JSON Schema describing the shape of the extracted value. The verifier uses this to check output stability across runs.

bind.description: Variable name to bind the extracted value to for use by later steps or as workflow output.

Wait.description: Wait for a condition to become true, or for a fixed duration. Prefer forCondition over millis; fixed waits are brittle.

millis.description: Fixed wait in milliseconds. Avoid when forCondition is possible.

Assert.description: Assert a condition explicitly as a step. Fails the workflow if the condition is false.

Guard.description: Conditional execution. Runs 'then' if 'if' holds, otherwise runs 'else' (if provided). Modelled after the design doc's 'cookie banner may or may not appear' pattern.

Loop.description: Repeated execution. Exactly one of foreach or while must be provided. 'foreach' iterates over elements matching a Target; 'while' repeats until a Condition stops holding. maxIterations is a safety cap.

maxIterations.description: Hard cap on iterations to prevent runaway loops when a 'while' condition fails to flip.
